text: 贵州茅台盘中重回A股“第一高价股”，盘中涨近2%，最高报1286.48元，联讯仪器日内跌超7.5%，股价一度失守1285元，总市值跌破2000亿。
text_en: Kweichow Moutai intraday reclaimed its position as the "highest-priced A-share," rising nearly 2% during the session to a high of 1,286.48 yuan, while Lianxun Instruments fell more than 7.5% during the day, with its share price briefly falling below 1,285 yuan and total market value dropping below 200 billion yuan.
